hook_line: 256 US LAWMAKERS BACK JULY AS INDIAN AMERICAN HERITAGE MONTH

hook_stat.sub: US lawmakers backing July as Indian American Heritage Month

stats.label: Members of the House of Representatives
Indian Americans recognised by the resolution

diaspora_bullets: More than half the House backs it
news_summary: A bipartisan House resolution to designate July as Indian American Heritage Month has 256 cosponsors, more than half of the 435-member House of Representatives.
payoff: The resolution has been referred to a House committee for consideration.
